=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/review_autofix_step_prepush_test_gate.sh:583-589,604-612,733-739,831-838 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The backup of untracked files is best-effort (`tar ... 2>/dev/null || rm -f "${rpg_untracked_backup}"`). If that backup fails and the repair turn then deletes an untracked editor file, the new `passing_change_erased` guard runs `review_prepush_test_gate_revert all`, which cannot restore the file, yet the guard still logs `outcome=repair_reverted reason=passing_change_erased`.
  WHY: The tar extract at lines 610-612 is skipped when `[ -s "${rpg_untracked_backup}" ]` is false, a missing backup produces no warning, and the deleted file is no longer in `git ls-files --others`, so the editor's change stays lost while the log claims a successful revert. All four flagging reviewers rated it MAJOR. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 disagreed: it judged the path real but not a defect, because the behaviour predates this PR (the lint-only guard at line 815 has the same gap), the outcome is no worse than without the guard, and the precondition is unlikely; it rated only the misleading log as a hardening nit.
- scripts/review_autofix_step_prepush_test_gate.sh:733-739,831-838 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The `passing_change_erased` guard can fire, and log `outcome=repair_reverted`, when the editor's only change is a NEW untracked file that did not exist when the backup was taken; `revert all` cannot recover that file because the tar at line 738 was created before the editor ran.
  WHY: The persist loop ends with `stop=reverted` on a misleading log, the commit step finds nothing to commit and reports "Editor changes lost", and the regression test does not cover this untracked-file scenario.

- scripts/review_autofix_step_prepush_test_gate.sh:lines 733-739, 583-589, 604-612, 831-838 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The `passing_change_erased` guard can fire and log `outcome=repair_reverted reason=passing_change_erased` in two cases. First, when the editor's only change is a new untracked file created after the backup at line 738, which `revert all` cannot recover. Second, when the tar at line 738 fails (`|| rm -f "${rpg_untracked_backup}"`) and the repair deletes an existing untracked file: `tar -xf` is skipped and `untracked[]` excludes the deleted file. The pre-existing `lint_only_change_erased` guard has the same blind spot.
  WHY: The persist loop ends with `stop=reverted` on a misleading log, the commit step finds nothing to commit and reports "Editor changes lost", and the real outcome is the same as if no guard had fired.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===
- scripts/review_autofix_step_prepush_test_gate.sh:735-738, 604-612, 831-836 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: If creating the untracked-file backup fails, the script deletes the partial archive and carries on. When the repair then deletes an untracked editor change, `review_prepush_test_gate_revert all` has no archive to restore from, but the new guard still logs `passing_change_erased` as though the change was kept.
  WHY: With a passing pre-repair result and a failed backup, a repair that deletes the editor's untracked file leaves the tree clean and satisfies the guard; the file cannot be restored, so the change stays lost while the run reports a successful revert.
=== END FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===

=== FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
- scripts/review_autofix_step_prepush_test_gate.sh:lines 737-738 (backup creation), 610-612 (restore gated on backup existence), 831-837 (new passing_change_erased guard) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The pre-repair untracked backup is best-effort (`tar ... 2>/dev/null || rm -f "${rpg_untracked_backup}"`), and the guard logs `reason=passing_change_erased` regardless of whether it exists. An untracked file deleted by the repair can only be restored by the tar extract at lines 610-612, which is skipped when the backup is absent. A missing backup raises no warning: `untracked_restore_failed` at line 611 fires only when `tar -xf` fails.
  WHY: The guard logs `outcome=repair_reverted reason=passing_change_erased` and reports "reverted (it removed the whole change though no test failed)", but nothing was restored, which is the exact "Editor changes lost" outcome #9519 targets. The agents.d fail-safe contract does not cover this case, and the pre-existing lint-only guard (line 815) has the same gap.
=== END FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
